دَالِجٌ One who takes the bucket and goes with it from the mouth of the well to the wateringtrough, to empty it therein. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And One who transfers the milk, when the camels have been milked, to the [large bowls called] جِفَان. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
